title: Lesson Planner Gym Placement Anchor Registry
description: Reusable one-item placement anchors traced from the yellow short-label squares in the owner-provided GYM LAYOUT 2.pdf. The PDF establishes label-anchor positions only; it is not physical gym geometry.

visibilityAndInteractionRules.showOnlyWhen: an editor has selected one unplaced idea or visual-text item and placement mode is active
visibilityAndInteractionRules.eligibleAnchorRule: show only anchors whose zoneIds intersect the phase-selected zones; show the union for a selected composite group
visibilityAndInteractionRules.afterPlacement: persist one placement to the chosen anchor, then immediately hide all anchors
visibilityAndInteractionRules.afterCancel: discard the transient selection and immediately hide all anchors
visibilityAndInteractionRules.capacityRule: each anchor accepts exactly one placed lesson item; occupied anchors are not eligible until the placement is moved or removed
visibilityAndInteractionRules.displayRule: render a concise descriptive label inside an occupied anchor; tapping that label opens the full drill/activity/reference detail such as rules, image, video, or other media

uncertainties.impact: Anchor coordinates must be registered to the Skeleton Freeform background before being overlaid on a rendered gym image. The anchor PDF may not be used to redraw physical equipment.

The source distinguishes a top/narrow Beam 2 area and a lower/wide Beam 2 area. They are mapped consistently to existing registry IDs zone-beam-2-a and zone-beam-2-b, but the A/B names remain owner-disambiguation placeholders.

Pit PB, Pit Rings/High Bar, and Tumble Track overlap in the zone reference. Anchors at those intersections intentionally list more than one zoneId; the UI must present a shared anchor once in a combined view, not duplicate it.

Two yellow plus-sign shapes inside the Trampoline artwork were not added as placement anchors because they lack the yellow Station-style label-anchor treatment. Confirm later if they should become separate anchors.
The 201 records are a conservative visual trace of completed yellow label boxes. Future edits should preserve existing IDs and add, move, or reject anchors only through an owner-reviewed revision.
